Grace / team — reviewed Clearsight_Redlines_20260802.pdf and prepared a tracked SOW (attached SOW_v2-tracked.docx) with the following approach:

1) Amendment vs Order Form: we can use a lightweight Amendment (Appendix: Phase 1 SOW) that references the Master Services Agreement. That avoids re-executing the MSA. I added language that: (a) preserves the MSA indemnities and (b) limits the amendment to the described phases.

2) Versioning model: propose a "Phase Appendix" pattern — each phase is an Appendix with acceptance criteria and KPIs. Appendix signed at phase start auto-amends the Order Form via reference. I've added an "execution by countersignature or DocuSign" clause.

3) Acceptance criteria: inserted staged criteria for smoke/perf tests and clear rollback triggers. Note: we need to be conservative on perf thresholds for phase 1 to avoid blocking launch; suggested thresholds included in the SOW (section 3.2).

4) Ops ownership and runbook updates: added an "Operational Handover" exhibit that requires runbook delivery and a named primary owner (we can populate names post-signing). This exhibit also defines the evidence that constitutes acceptance (logs, test harness urls, synthetic traffic results).

5) Pricing/managed-service scope: flagged two redlines from Cleansight that materially change the scope. Markus, I left comment bubbles where billing needs to confirm whether this is a billable add-on (monthly rate) or internal credit.

Deliverables: tracked SOW + draft Amendment text attached. I recommend we: (a) return to Cleansight with tracked SOW + summary of changes and (b) propose a short pilot acceptance window (7 calendar days) followed by a signed Appendix for phase 2.

If no legal blocking items, I can finalize amendment language by Wed morning.

Karthik Iyer

Redwood Inference

- Phase 1: pilot baseline (standard Order Form billing). Acceptance = smoke test + three basic perf checks (see section 3.2). Target sign-off: within 10 business days.
- Phase 2: managed-service option (only executed if both parties sign Appendix B). Pricing impact clearly called out as an add-on monthly fee; Markus will follow up with a rate card.
- Operational handback: Ops runbook delivery + named primary owner required before acceptance. Connor to own runbook delivery; Laura to draft acceptance checklist by EOD Thu.

Next steps:
1) We propose a short call Thurs 2026-08-05 11:00 AM PT to walk the tracked SOW and amend language (30 min).
